principle: 三条方法轴严格分离：选择轴 / 测量轴 / 证据轴。ChaosEater-adapter 与 ChaosEater official 是两个不同方法，不得混称。

axes.selection: 决定测哪个候选（排序/选择逻辑）
axes.measurement: 决定怎么测一个候选、看到什么防御
axes.evidence: 决定一次运行的证据链产出与判定

methods.known_limitations: no selectivity; wastes budget on protected edges (~49% in OB mixed pool)

methods.exact_definition: ChaosEater-selection-logic adapter + deepseek-v4-flash blind LLM (no contract knowledge)
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: fair for blind selection; NOT independent of our infra (candidate pool built by us, LLM calls via our adapter)
methods.known_limitations: blind single-sample hit is luck (not reproducible); cannot see code-level Future.get defense (measured in SOCK)

methods.exact_definition: global-graph static scorer (our methodology M3 lineage)
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: partially circular (D_known selected by M4 lineage)

methods.exact_definition: local-graph + runtime evidence scorer (our methodology M4 lineage)
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: partially circular (D_known selected by this lineage)

methods.known_limitations: ablation dimension, not a standalone method

methods.exact_definition: contract_inventory hard filter + SE/DP/JE rules, no LLM (our knowledge-assetized selector)
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: knowledge may be post-hoc (SOCK registrations written after experiments; see freeze_snapshot note). r2 pool has no SOCK candidates so unaffected.
methods.known_limitations: protected-edge skip only helps when pool has protected edges; on homogeneous weak pools (r2) U@8 ties with blind

methods.exact_definition: decision_engine (contract inventory + knowledge) as the 'ours' method in r2 head-to-head
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: frozen pre-execution for r2 (rankings_frozen.json); knowledge timing honest note recorded
methods.known_limitations: ties with CE-adapter and Random on homogeneous r2 pool (U@8 6 vs 6 vs 5)

methods.exact_definition: LLM blind ranker using ChaosEater-derived prompt style, run through our OpenAI-compat adapter. NOT the official deployed ChaosEater.
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: fair for blind selection; NOT 'ChaosEater official' - see separate entry
methods.known_limitations: single-sample blind hit is luck; no source verification capability

methods.exact_definition: official ChaosEater (ASE 2025, commit 47c4e44) fully deployed and run as a complete hypothesis->experiment->analysis->improvement cycle on Sock Shop
methods.input_information_tier: full repo, manifests, LLM agents (deepseek-v4-flash via env base_url)
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: independent deployment, single run; findings compared separately (supplementary), NOT merged into a single score
methods.known_limitations: steady-state = availableReplicas; cannot see HTTP contract-layer defenses (structural blindness)

methods.exact_definition: ChaosEater AnalysisAgent prompt used to classify OUR executed candidates (14 candidates fed with real experiment data)
methods.input_information_tier: our experiment data + CE analysis prompt
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: self-referential: our severity/root-cause definitions, our data; cannot claim superiority
methods.known_limitations: 6/14 missed 'experiment passed' cases; 0/14 structured root cause; output-form difference not superiority

methods.exact_definition: direct port/service-level injection and measurement (curl/HTTPChaos to service port)
methods.known_limitations: cannot see code-level async timeouts (SOCK Future.get invisible: direct 12s hang vs real-chain 5s timeout)

methods.exact_definition: business-entry measurement through the real service chain (e.g. POST /orders -> user/carts/payment/shipping)
methods.runtime_runner: curl POST /orders (sock) / ob_client gRPC checkout (OB r2)
methods.known_limitations: requires business data setup; but exposes code-level defenses direct cannot see

methods.exact_definition: deployment-availability sampling: pod-kill + 500ms Ready-pod curve (redundancy/self-heal defense)
methods.evidence_output: availability curve, outage window, recovery time
methods.fair_head_to_head_status: n/a (measurement axis); CE parity: our static+kill reproduced CE's front-end finding
methods.known_limitations: recovery times polluted by cluster load; availability layer alone cannot see contract defenses

evidence_methods: our evidence chain (baseline/injection/recovery/cleanup + RCA + knowledge reflow)
summary.ce_adapter_vs_official_note: ChaosEater-adapter is a blind LLM ranker via our adapter. ChaosEater-official is the deployed full cycle (commit 47c4e44). They are distinct methods and are NOT interchangeable in claims.
